name: Review & diff
tagline: Streamed diff, inline comments, pending review
summary: The Files changed view of a pull request: a streamed, syntax-highlighted diff with a file tree, inline comment threads, and a pending review you submit as a comment, approval or change request.

flow.label: Review page route
flow.note: Prefetches PR data and file summaries without blocking; cold loads show diff-shaped skeletons.

flow.label: usePullDiffFiles
flow.note: Looks for this revision in memory, then IndexedDB, and otherwise fetches /api/pulls/diff.

flow.label: /api/pulls/diff
flow.note: Pipes GitHub's diff through; if GitHub says too large, tries the public .diff URL, else answers 413.

flow.label: Git diff splitter
flow.note: Cuts the stream at each 'diff --git' header and hands parsed files to the page in batches.

flow.label: DiffCodeView
flow.note: Pierre's CodeView draws files with sticky headers and comment annotations; workers do the highlighting.

flow.label: submitPullReview
flow.note: Posts the summary, the verdict and every pending line comment as one GitHub review.

features.name: Streamed diff loading
features.summary: One raw diff request, parsed per file inside an 8 ms work budget. First paint after 12 files or 150 ms. Too-large diffs fall back to the paged files API.

entry.role: Cache lookup, stream, paged fallback
Server handler behind /api/pulls/diff
Splits a byte stream into per-file diffs

features.name: Diff cache per commit
features.summary: A revision (repo, PR, head commit, base branch) never changes, so its raw diff is kept in IndexedDB for 7 days and parsed diffs stay in memory for the tab.

entry.role: IndexedDB store, 40 MB cap per user
In-memory parsed diffs for instant return

features.name: Renderer and highlighting
features.summary: @pierre/diffs CodeView with a worker pool (up to 3 workers, 1 on small touch devices). Uses Pierre's WASM highlighter when it can, Shiki in JS otherwise.

entry.role: Highlighter, themes and worker pool
CodeView wrapper with review annotations
Loads viewer and workers ahead of render

features.name: Files and commits panel
features.summary: Resizable side panel with a @pierre/trees file tree that fills in up to 500 files per request and follows your scroll, plus a commits tab. A drawer on phones.

entry.role: Changed-files tree
Pages file summaries in automatically
GraphQL file list, 5 pages per call

features.name: Inline comment threads
features.summary: The gutter button on a line or selected range opens a comment form. Existing threads sit on their line with reply, edit, and resolve or unresolve.

entry.role: A posted thread inside the diff
Form for a new line comment
Arranges comments by file and line

features.name: Pending review and submit
features.summary: New comments queue as pending bubbles. Submit review sends them with a summary as Comment, Approve or Request changes, then returns to the PR page.

entry.role: State of the review being written
Sends the review and refreshes the PR
Summary field and verdict choice

features.name: Viewed files and options
features.summary: Ticking Viewed collapses a file and moves a progress meter; ticks reset on a new head commit. Split or unified and wrap lines; phones are always unified.

entry.role: In-memory set of viewed paths
Split, unified and wrap controls
Placeholder diff for cold loads

entryPoints.role: Review page: layout, queries, draft state
How the diff gets loaded, cached and streamed
Server side of /api/pulls/diff, pure and tested
The viewer shared by review, commit and compare pages
Review server functions: comments, threads, submit

goodParts: The diff route's logic is a pure handler with injected fetchers (lib/pull-diff-request.server.ts) and a test file next to it.
The stream splitter, draft reducer and comment cache patching have unit tests; apps/e2e/tests/isolated/review-submission.spec.ts covers submitting.
watch: The loader prefetches the paged pulls/files query (review.$pullId.tsx:29), which the page reads only when the diff is too large (use-pull-diff-files.ts:196).
Pending comments and Viewed ticks live only in page memory (review-draft.ts, viewed-files-store.ts); a reload drops them and Viewed is never sent to GitHub.
createReviewComment is exported (lib/github/reviews.ts:235) but nothing calls it; new line comments only go out inside a submitted review.
